findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order, get_trading_routine · Private data: get_growth_plan, get_my_mt5_account, place_mt5_order, modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order, get_trading_routine, record_backtest_result, save_daily_plan, set_price_alert · Public sink: modify_mt5_order · Destructive: modify_mt5_order, record_backtest_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order, get_trading_routine · Private data: get_growth_plan, get_my_mt5_account, place_mt5_order, modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order, get_trading_routine, record_backtest_result, save_daily_plan, set_price_alert · Public sink: modify_mt5_order · Destructive: modify_mt5_order, record_backtest_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
